headline: South Africa Fuel Levy Cut Set to Start November 4
summary: The South Africa fuel levy falls by US$0.18 a litre on diesel and US$0.09 on petrol starting November 4 at a US$610 million cost.
why: Lowering fuel levies can temporarily relieve consumer price pressures and transportation costs, directly influencing retail inflation metrics.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: State-mandated fuel tax reductions lower pump prices and ease logistics costs for businesses.
